t.E316.agn: In 2016 EFSA saw no reason to change the existing acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 6 mg/kg body weight and found no safety concern at the permitted use levels.
t.E316.body: In the body it behaves like erythorbic acid; its vitamin C activity is very weak.
t.E316.prod: Produced from glucose by steps combining fermentation and chemical synthesis (via 2-keto-D-gluconic acid).
t.E316.regx.0: Re-evaluated; existing ADI (6 mg/kg body weight/day) maintained, no safety concern.
t.E316.summary: The sodium salt of erythorbic acid. It preserves colour in processed meats.
t.E316.what: It is the sodium salt of erythorbic acid; it helps preserve colour and slow oxidation in processed meats.
